audit.why: HARD / 8-10 alongside a 50.38% win rate over 1975 games is a difficulty rating about execution, not outcome, and the prose supports it: Wind Wall deletes the Q pattern the whole kit is built on.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was generic filler naming no Yasuo mechanic.
audit.why: The level-6 beat in this lane is denying the second Steel Tempest stack so Last Breath has no airborne target — that is the spike.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around the knock-up denial and his crit curve.

audit.whatIsWrong: Way of the Wanderer's moving shield is never mentioned anywhere on the page, so the burst maths the all-in advice assumes is wrong.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Yasuo builds toward a shield whenever he is moving. The shield triggers when he takes damage from a champion.' A laning Yasuo is nearly always moving, so the first hit of your pattern is absorbed and the recast is what actually starts the trade.
audit.corrected: report[5].t and breakdown.early rewritten to state the shield and the order it forces.

audit.why: Wind Wall blocking the Q in both directions is right — Aurora's Q carries the projectile flag and Riot's Wind Wall text blocks all enemy projectiles. Note it blocks projectiles only, so it does not stop your W or R leaps; the page correctly never claims otherwise.
breakdown.cooldowns carries 25s/4s Wind Wall, the 4s Steel Tempest, and 70s Last Breath.
